analogy.rationale: MLCK is a calcium/calmodulin-dependent kinase with limited expression in these cell lines, so MLCK inhibitors should produce little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other modulators of the same calcium-calmodulin contractility pathway (ROCK, calmodulin) or broadly related kinase/calcium classes.
